subject: Urgent: Novasearch renewal - bench + intervention roadmap
messages:
From: Alyssa Green <alyssa.green@novasearch.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novasearch.ai
Date: 2028-10-01 09:12 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal check-in

Hi Hannah,

Quick escalation from our side — we had an internal spike in usage over the summer and our infra team ran a light bake-off with CloudPort that showed ~15% lower tail latency at our 10k seq workloads. Procurement has line-of-sight to competitive pricing that looks attractive for next year.

Before we push for a switch, the product and infra teams want a short benchmark with our real dataset and a clear uplift commitment from Redwood if we choose to expand capacity.

Can you run a dedicated proof with our anonymized logs (I've attached the benchmark instructions) and provide a brief commercial proposal that includes:
- 6/12 month committed capacity pricing buckets for 3 workload tiers
- Any performance guarantees (p50/p95/p99) we can set in contract
- An incentive for a 12-month renewal + expansion (discount or credits)

We'd need results by Oct 16 to inform our Q4 planning. Appreciate a clear owner and timeline.

Thanks,
Alyssa
VP, Platform
Novasearch

Attachment: novasearch-benchmark-instructions.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01 11:03 PDT
Subject: Fwd: Renewal check-in / Novasearch request

Team — forwarding Alyssa's note. TL;DR: Novasearch is actively evaluating a competitor after a light bake-off; they want a hands-on benchmark with their dataset + a commercial proposal by Oct 16. Critical ask is both performance (tail latency) and a clear expansion discount.

Ask list (owner suggestions):
- Ben: run the bench with their harness and confirm test matrix and infra footprint. Will need a small dedicated pool for 48 hours to reproduce 10k seq p99s (owner: ben).
- Rishi: pricing/term options and suggested credit tiers for a 12-month expansion (owner: rishi).
- Marissa: lead the renewal negotiation and customer comms; coordinate procurement and DocuSign flow (owner: marissa).

I've attached the benchmark doc from Alyssa. Ben — can you confirm what we need (data subsets, test keys, access window) and whether eng needs to stand by? Rishi/Marissa — target a draft term-sheet by Oct 6 so there's runway for review.

Thanks — Hannah
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-02 15:20 PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal check-in / Novasearch request

Hannah / Marissa — I reviewed the attached instructions. Technical notes and runbook: 

- We need a sanitized slice of their request logs (5GB compressed) and an explicit mapping of their sequence-length distribution. If they can drop logs into the Drive link by EOD Oct 4 we can schedule a 48h dedicated run starting Oct 9.
- Proposed infra: 2 x A100-equivalent nodes with our low-latency kernel + continuous batching enabled; KV cache warmup step required (we'll include scripts).
- Bench matrix: 3 workload tiers (baseline/medium/peak) x 3 concurrency points. Measure p50/p95/p99 and cost per 1k tokens.
- Risk: if they insist on running head-to-head simultaneous against CloudPort they'll push for identical infra; we can offer a dedicated window and produce side-by-side metrics normalized by hw.

I'll prepare the test harness and a runbook and request an eng on-call (I can get one of our infra leads). Ben
Staff Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: redwood-runbook-bench-harness-v1.txt (internal)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Green <alyssa.green@novasearch.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novasearch.ai
Date: 2028-10-03 08:45 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal check-in — proposed timeline and interim offer

Alyssa — thanks for outlining the ask and timeline. We're prepared to move fast. Proposed plan: 

1) Bench window: Redwood runs Oct 9 - Oct 10 (48h). Ben will share runbook and we will provide test keys and a dedicated pool.
2) Commercial: we can offer a conditional expansion package — 15% off baseline per-token price for a 12-month commit that includes a 1-month free trial of burst capacity. If the benchmark shows p99 within 10% of CloudPort's numbers on their 10k seq test, we'll hold the offer for 30 days.
3) Legal/procurement: I'll send a draft term-sheet for internal review by Oct 6 (attached). If acceptable, we will send a DocuSign renewal + expansion quote to Procurement for signature.

Links / notes: HubSpot: HS-Contact-01234; DocuSign preview: https://docusign.com/nt/renewal/NV-2028-1457

Next steps: Alyssa — can Procurement confirm access to the logs by Oct 4 and a preferred SLA to include in the term-sheet (target p99/p95)? If we get that, Ben and I will start the bench prep.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, West
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-term-sheet-v2.pdf

From: Alyssa Green <alyssa.green@novasearch.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novasearch.ai, Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudport.com>
Date: 2028-10-03 16:12 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal check-in — proposed timeline and interim offer

Marissa / Hannah — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the conditional offer. Procurement will drop the sanitized logs into the Drive link by COB Oct 4. We accept the Oct 9-10 bench window.

Two clarifications before we kick off: 
- We'll need an explicit fallback plan if the bench shows CloudPort materially better on p99 despite identical hw (we're trying to avoid a mid-contract migration). Can you propose an operational remediation (e.g., 8-week optimization project + credits) we can include in the SLA?
- On the commercial side, the 15% expansion discount looks good; Procurement will want that codified in the term-sheet (we'll put redlines to legal if needed).

I'll loop legal and procurement on next steps. Samir — please stand by for coordination if we run the parallel head-to-head.

Thanks,
Alyssa
VP, Platform
Novasearch
